intro: Captain Danuvin is an officer stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall, serving as one of the leaders tasked with holding the frontier together. Working alongside the People's Militia, he directs volunteers and recruits to patrol the roads and push back against encroaching Gnolls and outlaws. His commands are vital to keeping the supply lines and farmlands from falling completely into hostile hands.

p: Perched at the fortified tower of Sentinel Hill, Captain Danuvin coordinates ground patrols across Westfall. The region has spiraled into chaos with the withdrawal of regular Stormwind garrison troops, leaving local defenses severely depleted. Danuvin relies heavily on wandering adventurers, local farmhands, and volunteer fighters to maintain even a semblance of order across the grassy plains.

Danuvin's immediate strategic concern is the security of the roadways and open lands around Sentinel Hill. With the Riverpaw Gnolls growing bolder and raiding close to central outposts, he organizes active patrols to cull their packs and secure the perimeter. His orders help prevent the encampment from being entirely surrounded by Westfall's opportunists and marauders.
